topics.name: Canonical Patch Rebase and Conflict
topics.purpose: Define deterministic handling when patch base no longer matches accepted repository state, using exact identity/semantic conflict evidence instead of last-write-wins.

semantics.base_rule: Current accepted source-set is compared to patch expected base.
semantics.conflict_rule: Overlapping semantic changes produce explicit conflict.
semantics.nonoverlap_rule: Non-overlapping compatible changes may be rebased through explicit deterministic semantics.
semantics.identity_rule: Identity rename/removal/reference conflicts are surfaced explicitly.
semantics.order_rule: Patch arrival time or newest timestamp never wins automatically.
semantics.auto_rule: Automatic rebase is allowed only for provably semantics-preserving changes.

invariants.rule: Contract Format bootstrap authority, canonical contract sources, generated projections, historical artifacts and runtime state remain separate identities/roles; no file becomes authoritative merely by name, path order, timestamp or discovery order.
Candidate canonical changes remain inert until exact format validation, identity/reference resolution, semantic diff, applicable governance/authorization and repository acceptance succeed.

references.purpose: Rebase handles exact patch base mismatch.
